title: Online Conformal Prediction via Universal Portfolio Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2602.03168v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Online conformal prediction (OCP) seeks prediction intervals that achieve long-run $1-\alpha$ coverage for arbitrary (possibly adversarial) data streams, while remaining as informative as possible. Existing OCP methods often require manual learning-rate tuning to work well, and may also require algorithm-specific analyses. Here, we develop a general regret-to-coverage theory for interval-valued OCP based on the $(1-\alpha)$-pinball loss. Our first contribution is to identify \emph{linearized regret} as a key notion, showing that controlling it implies coverage bounds for any online algorithm. This relies on a black-box reduction that depends only on the Fenchel conjugate of an upper bound on the linearized regret. Building on this theory, we propose UP-OCP, a parameter-free method for OCP, via a reduction to a two-asset portfolio selection problem, leveraging universal portfolio algorithms. translated_title: 基于通用投资组合算法的在线保形预测
translated_abstract: 在线保形预测（OCP）旨在为任意（可能是对抗性的）数据流提供能够实现长期 1-α 覆盖率的预测区间，同时尽可能保持区间信息量。现有的OCP方法通常需要手动调整学习率才能良好工作，并且可能还需要针对特定算法的分析。在本文中，我们基于 (1-α)-pinball 损失，为区间值OCP发展了一套通用的“遗憾到覆盖”理论。我们的第一个贡献是识别出“线性化遗憾”这一关键概念，表明控制该量即可为任何在线算法导出覆盖界。这一结果依赖于一个黑盒归约，其仅依赖于线性化遗憾上界的Fenchel共轭。基于这一理论，我们通过将OCP问题归约为两资产投资组合选择问题，并利用通用投资组合算法，提出了UP-OCP——一种无需调参的OCP方法。我们展示了在……上的强有限时间界。
tldr: 本文识别出“线性化遗憾”这一关键概念并建立了通用的“遗憾到覆盖”理论，据此提出无需任何参数调整的UP-OCP方法，通过将问题归约为两资产投资组合选择问题并利用通用投资组合算法，实现了参数无关的在线保形预测覆盖率保证。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies linearized regret as a key notion to establish a general regret-to-coverage theory, and proposes UP-OCP, a parameter-free online conformal prediction method that achieves coverage guarantees by reducing the problem to a two-asset portfolio selection problem via universal portfolio algorithms.
